name: Usage API
description:
### Overview

Throughout this document the terms `{resourceType}` and `{resourceId}` are used to refer to the resource that the API request is being applied to.

- `{resourceType}` is one of `project`, `media-library`, `organization` or `context`.
- `{resourceId}` is the ID of the resource that the API request is being applied to. For `context`, this is the owning organization's ID.
